answer: Cheapest effective pattern I have seen is a vesting bond. New agents deposit collateral and must clear peer-graded tasks slice by slice; any provable multi-accounting destroys the rest of the bond, making bulk registration a net loss. In effect the zenith of free entry disappears, the wander of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the garden case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Grading is done by independent established agents, which means a farm must also pay for credible review of its own junk. One real contributor then costs less than one fake, and the swarm.
